en: oh
zh: 喔
ja: ああ

en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察到自然界的變化模式，
ja: 2000年以上前、古代中国の学者たちは自然界の変化する様子を観察しました。
local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
ja_pron: nisen nen ijō mae, kodai chūgoku no gakusha-tachi wa shizen-kai no henka suru yōsu o kansatsu shimashita
native: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural

en: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
zh: 包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
ja: 気候や季節の移り変わり、天文学などです。
local: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
ja_pron: kikō ya kisetsu no utsurikawari, tenmongaku nado desu
native: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating
zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行分為24條路徑，創造了
ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の区分に分けました。
local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating
ja_pron: gakusha-tachi wa taiyō no nenkan no ugoki o sokutei shi, nijūyon no kubun ni wakemashita
native: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating

en: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
zh: 二十四節氣，這些節氣用來管理古代中國的農業。
ja: 二十四節気を作り、古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
local: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
ja_pron: nijūshi sekki o tsukuri, kodai chūgoku no nōgyō o kanri suru tame ni tsukawaremashita
native: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds
zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍指引著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の中国人の生活と伝統を導いています。
local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds
ja_pron: kyō ni itaru made, kono hatsumei wa sū oku-nin no chūgokujin no seikatsu to dentō o michibiiteimasu
native: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds

en: of millions of Chinese people.
zh: 數以億計的中國人。
ja: 何億もの中国人の生活を支えています。
local: of millions of Chinese people.
ja_pron: nan oku mono chūgokujin no seikatsu o sasaeteimasu
native: of millions of Chinese people.

en: On core around the 7th of November each year, China ushers in the first solar term of winter
zh: 每年11月7日左右，中國迎來冬季的第一個節氣，立冬。
ja: 毎年11月7日頃、中国は冬の最初の節気「立冬」を迎えます。
local: On core around the 7th of November each year, China ushers in the first solar term of winter
ja_pron: maitoshi jūichigatsu nanoka goro, chūgoku wa fuyu no saisho no sekki 'rittō' o mukaemasu
native: On core around the 7th of November each year, China ushers in the first solar term of winter

en: lead on.
zh: 立冬。
ja: 立冬です。
local: lead on.
ja_pron: rittō desu
native: lead on.

en: At this time of year, the water is icing over and the ground starts freezing.
zh: 這個時節，水面開始結冰，土地開始凍結。
ja: この時期、水は凍り始め、地面も凍り始めます。
local: At this time of year, the water is icing over and the ground starts freezing.
ja_pron: kono jiki, mizu wa kōri hajime, jimen mo kōri hajimemasu
native: At this time of year, the water is icing over and the ground starts freezing.

en: It's the season for harvesting, offering sacrifices and celebrating with banquets and
zh: 這是收穫、祭祀和宴會慶祝的季節，
ja: 収穫や祭祀、宴会で祝う季節です。
local: It's the season for harvesting, offering sacrifices and celebrating with banquets and
ja_pron: shūkaku ya saishi, enkai de iwau kisetsu desu
native: It's the season for harvesting, offering sacrifices and celebrating with banquets and

en: the particles.
zh: 親朋好友聚會。
ja: 親しい人たちが集まります。
local: the particles.
ja_pron: shitashii hitotachi ga atsumarimasu
native: the particles.

en: The start of winter, lead on, is the 19th solar term of the 24.
zh: 立冬是二十四節氣中的第十九個節氣。
ja: 立冬は二十四節気の19番目です。
local: The start of winter, lead on, is the 19th solar term of the 24.
ja_pron: rittō wa nijūshi sekki no jūkyū-banme desu
native: The start of winter, lead on, is the 19th solar term of the 24.

en: The Chinese character lead means begin.
zh: 漢字「立」的意思是開始。
ja: 漢字の「立」は始まりを意味します。
local: The Chinese character lead means begin.
ja_pron: kanji no 'ritsu' wa hajimari o imi shimasu
native: The Chinese character lead means begin.

en: Lead on is the day when people in China welcome in the winter season, come what may.
zh: 立冬是中國人迎接冬季的日子，不論任何情況。
ja: 立冬は中国の人々が冬の季節を迎える日です、どんなことがあっても。
local: Lead on is the day when people in China welcome in the winter season, come what may.
ja_pron: rittō wa chūgoku no hitobito ga fuyu no kisetsu o mukaeru hi desu, donna koto ga atte mo
native: Lead on is the day when people in China welcome in the winter season, come what may.

en: Ancient China was a traditional farming society.
zh: 古代中國是一個傳統的農業社會。
ja: 古代中国は伝統的な農耕社会でした。
local: Ancient China was a traditional farming society.
ja_pron: kodai chūgoku wa dentō-teki na nōkō shakai deshita
native: Ancient China was a traditional farming society.

en: In spring, summer and autumn, the farmers work hard.
zh: 春、夏、秋三季，農民們努力耕作。
ja: 春、夏、秋には農民たちは一生懸命働きます。
local: In spring, summer and autumn, the farmers work hard.
ja_pron: haru, natsu, aki ni wa nōmin-tachi wa isshōkenmei hatarakimasu
native: In spring, summer and autumn, the farmers work hard.

en: In winter, as long as the storm is stopped to the brim with rain, the family just has to
zh: 冬天，只要風暴停止，家人只需
ja: 冬は嵐が止み、雨が降り続く限り、家族はただ
local: In winter, as long as the storm is stopped to the brim with rain, the family just has to
ja_pron: fuyu wa arashi ga yami, ame ga furitsuzuku kagiri, kazoku wa tada
native: In winter, as long as the storm is stopped to the brim with rain, the family just has to

en: keep warm and wait for the new year to arrive.
zh: 保暖並等待新年的到來。
ja: 暖かくして新年を待つだけです。
local: keep warm and wait for the new year to arrive.
ja_pron: atatakaku shite shinnen o matsu dake desu
native: keep warm and wait for the new year to arrive.

en: At the start of winter in northern China, nothing grows in the forests and fields.
zh: 在中國北方的冬季開始，森林和田野中沒有植物生長。
ja: 中国北部の冬の始まりには、森や畑に何も育ちません。
local: At the start of winter in northern China, nothing grows in the forests and fields.
ja_pron: chūgoku hokubu no fuyu no hajimari ni wa, mori ya hatake ni nanimo sodachimasen
native: At the start of winter in northern China, nothing grows in the forests and fields.

en: Crop fields like dormant and the ground is left to slowly freeze.
zh: 農田像是休眠，土地慢慢結冰。
ja: 作物の畑は休眠状態になり、地面はゆっくりと凍ります。
local: Crop fields like dormant and the ground is left to slowly freeze.
ja_pron: sakumotsu no hatake wa kyūmin jōtai ni nari, jimen wa yukkuri to kōrimasu
native: Crop fields like dormant and the ground is left to slowly freeze.

en: In the fairly warm south, a new sport crux up in early winter, winter swimming.
zh: 在相當溫暖的南方，初冬出現了一項新運動，冬泳。
ja: 比較暖かい南部では、初冬に新しいスポーツ、冬泳が始まります。
local: In the fairly warm south, a new sport crux up in early winter, winter swimming.
ja_pron: hikaku atatakai nanbu de wa, shoto ni atarashii supōtsu, tōei ga hajimarimasu
native: In the fairly warm south, a new sport crux up in early winter, winter swimming.

en: Shouting in Jurgang Province is a city moistened by the lake it surrounds, homes on the
zh: 浙江省紹興是一座被湖泊環繞的城市，湖邊有居民。
ja: 浙江省の紹興は湖に囲まれた街で、湖のほとりに家があります。
local: Shouting in Jurgang Province is a city moistened by the lake it surrounds, homes on the
ja_pron: Zhejiang-shō no Shōkō wa mizuumi ni kakomareta machi de, mizuumi no hotori ni ie ga arimasu
native: Shouting in Jurgang Province is a city moistened by the lake it surrounds, homes on the

en: shore house the locals.
zh: 岸邊是當地居民的家。
ja: 岸辺には地元の人々の家があります。
local: shore house the locals.
ja_pron: kishibe ni wa jimoto no hitobito no ie ga arimasu
native: shore house the locals.

en: Dignon Falls like in retirement is much like that of many older people in China today.
zh: 丁堰鎮的退休生活與今天中國許多老年人的生活相似。
ja: 丁堰の退職後の生活は、今日の中国の多くの高齢者の生活に似ています。
local: Dignon Falls like in retirement is much like that of many older people in China today.
ja_pron: Chōen no taishoku-go no seikatsu wa, kyō no chūgoku no ōku no kōrei-sha no seikatsu ni niteimasu
native: Dignon Falls like in retirement is much like that of many older people in China today.

en: Flying food, cooking, picking up the grandkids from the school.
zh: 買菜、做飯、接孫子放學。
ja: 食材の買い物、料理、孫を学校から迎えに行くこと。
local: Flying food, cooking, picking up the grandkids from the school.
ja_pron: shokuzai no kaimono, ryōri, mago o gakkō kara mukae ni iku koto
native: Flying food, cooking, picking up the grandkids from the school.

en: But aside from all that, the gin couple have a special hobby in common, winter swimming.
zh: 但除此之外，這對老夫妻有一個共同的特殊愛好，冬泳。
ja: しかしそれ以外に、この老夫婦には共通の特別な趣味があります。それは冬泳です。
local: But aside from all that, the gin couple have a special hobby in common, winter swimming.
ja_pron: shikashi sore igai ni, kono rōfūfu ni wa kyōtsū no tokubetsu na shumi ga arimasu. sore wa tōei desu
native: But aside from all that, the gin couple have a special hobby in common, winter swimming.

en: They do this every single morning, all gin has even turned his hobby into a post-retirement
zh: 他們每天早晨都這樣做，老金甚至將他的愛好變成了退休後的事業，
ja: 彼らは毎朝これを行い、老金さんは趣味を退職後の仕事にまでしています。
local: They do this every single morning, all gin has even turned his hobby into a post-retirement
ja_pron: karera wa maiasa kore o okonai, Rō Kin-san wa shumi o taishoku-go no shigoto ni made shiteimasu
native: They do this every single morning, all gin has even turned his hobby into a post-retirement

en: career.
zh: 事業。
ja: 仕事です。
local: career.
ja_pron: shigoto desu
native: career.

en: He is the vice president of the Xiaoshing Winter Swimming Association.
zh: 他是紹興冬泳協會的副會長。
ja: 彼は紹興冬泳協会の副会長です。
local: He is the vice president of the Xiaoshing Winter Swimming Association.
ja_pron: kare wa Shōkō Tōei Kyōkai no fuku kaichō desu
native: He is the vice president of the Xiaoshing Winter Swimming Association.

en: Winter swimming is swimming outdoors in water that has not been artificially heated.
zh: 冬泳是在未經人工加熱的戶外水域游泳。
ja: 冬泳とは、人工的に温められていない水で屋外で泳ぐことです。
local: Winter swimming is swimming outdoors in water that has not been artificially heated.
ja_pron: tōei to wa, jinkō-teki ni atatamerarete inai mizu de okugai de oyogu koto desu
native: Winter swimming is swimming outdoors in water that has not been artificially heated.

en: The air temperature should be below 10 degrees Celsius and the water temperature below
zh: 空氣溫度應低於攝氏10度，水溫低於
ja: 気温は摂氏10度以下、水温は以下でなければなりません。
local: The air temperature should be below 10 degrees Celsius and the water temperature below
ja_pron: kion wa sesshi 10-do ika, suion wa ika de nakereba narimasen
native: The air temperature should be below 10 degrees Celsius and the water temperature below

en: 17 degrees Celsius.
zh: 攝氏17度。
ja: 摂氏17度です。
local: 17 degrees Celsius.
ja_pron: sesshi 17-do desu
native: 17 degrees Celsius.

en: Dignon, the first air winter, is symbolically the first day of the winter swimming season.
zh: 丁堰，冬季的第一個節氣，象徵著冬泳季的第一天。
ja: 丁堰は冬の最初の節気であり、冬泳シーズンの初日を象徴しています。
local: Dignon, the first air winter, is symbolically the first day of the winter swimming season.
ja_pron: Chōen wa fuyu no saisho no sekki de ari, tōei shīzun no shonichi o shōchō shiteimasu
native: Dignon, the first air winter, is symbolically the first day of the winter swimming season.

en: As a water town, Xiaoshing has everything it needs to be a perfect place for winter swimming.
zh: 作為水鄉，紹興擁有冬泳所需的一切條件，是理想的地點。
ja: 水の町として、紹興は冬泳に最適な環境をすべて備えています。
local: As a water town, Xiaoshing has everything it needs to be a perfect place for winter swimming.
ja_pron: mizu no machi to shite, Shōkō wa tōei ni saiteki na kankyō o subete sonaeteimasu
native: As a water town, Xiaoshing has everything it needs to be a perfect place for winter swimming.

en: This year's National Winter Swimming Championships will be held here.
zh: 今年的全國冬泳錦標賽將在此舉行。
ja: 今年の全国冬泳選手権大会はここで開催されます。
local: This year's National Winter Swimming Championships will be held here.
ja_pron: kotoshi no zenkoku tōei senshuken taikai wa koko de kaisai saremasu
native: This year's National Winter Swimming Championships will be held here.

en: Old gin is one of the organizers.
zh: 老金是組織者之一。
ja: 老金さんは主催者の一人です。
local: Old gin is one of the organizers.
ja_pron: Rō Kin-san wa shusai-sha no hitori desu
native: Old gin is one of the organizers.

en: He leads the daily practice sessions for participants.
zh: 他帶領參賽者進行每日練習。
ja: 彼は参加者の毎日の練習を指導しています。
local: He leads the daily practice sessions for participants.
ja_pron: kare wa sanka-sha no mainichi no renshū o shidō shiteimasu
native: He leads the daily practice sessions for participants.

en: This entails swimming up and down the ginful lake.
zh: 這包括在金湖中來回游泳。
ja: これは金湖を上下に泳ぐことを含みます。
local: This entails swimming up and down the ginful lake.
ja_pron: kore wa Kin-ko o jōge ni oyogu koto o fukumi masu
native: This entails swimming up and down the ginful lake.

en: People say the lake has the best water quality and the best environment for winter swimming.
zh: 人們說這湖水質最好，冬泳環境最佳。
ja: 人々はこの湖が最高の水質と冬泳に最適な環境を持っていると言います。
local: People say the lake has the best water quality and the best environment for winter swimming.
ja_pron: hitobito wa kono mizuumi ga saikō no suishitsu to tōei ni saiteki na kankyō o motte iru to iimasu
native: People say the lake has the best water quality and the best environment for winter swimming.

en: Although I am not as crazy about it as Mr. Jin,
zh: 雖然我不像金先生那麼瘋狂，
ja: 私は金さんほど熱中していませんが、
local: Although I am not as crazy about it as Mr. Jin,
ja_pron: watashi wa Kin-san hodo necchū shite imasen ga
native: Although I am not as crazy about it as Mr. Jin,

en: I do take the occasional dip in Beijing's whole high lake in the winter.
zh: 冬天我偶爾會在北京的後海游泳。
ja: 冬には時々北京の後海で泳ぎます。
local: I do take the occasional dip in Beijing's whole high lake in the winter.
ja_pron: fuyu ni wa tokidoki Pekin no Hòuhǎi de oyogimasu
native: I do take the occasional dip in Beijing's whole high lake in the winter.

en: It's a good exercise for the heart and brain.
zh: 這對心臟和大腦是很好的鍛鍊。
ja: これは心臓と脳に良い運動です。
local: It's a good exercise for the heart and brain.
ja_pron: kore wa shinzō to nō ni yoi undō desu
native: It's a good exercise for the heart and brain.

en: When stimulated by cold water, your blood vessels expand and contract.
zh: 當冷水刺激時，血管會擴張和收縮。
ja: 冷たい水に刺激されると、血管が拡張と収縮を繰り返します。
local: When stimulated by cold water, your blood vessels expand and contract.
ja_pron: tsumetai mizu ni shigeki sareru to, kekkan ga kakuchō to shūshuku o kurikaeshimasu
native: When stimulated by cold water, your blood vessels expand and contract.

en: After a workout like this, they can take anything.
zh: 經過這樣的鍛鍊後，血管能承受任何挑戰。
ja: このような運動の後、血管はどんな負荷にも耐えられます。
local: After a workout like this, they can take anything.
ja_pron: kono yō na undō no ato, kekkan wa donna fuka ni mo taeraremasu
native: After a workout like this, they can take anything.

en: You can feel your circulation and metabolism getting stronger.
zh: 你會感覺到血液循環和新陳代謝變得更強。
ja: 血液循環と新陳代謝が強くなるのを感じられます。
local: You can feel your circulation and metabolism getting stronger.
ja_pron: ketsueki junkan to shinchintaisha ga tsuyoku naru no o kanjirareru
native: You can feel your circulation and metabolism getting stronger.

en: If you get to swim in the early morning in winter, it will put you in a good mood all day.
zh: 如果你能在冬天清晨游泳，整天心情都會很好。
ja: 冬の早朝に泳ぐことができれば、一日中気分が良くなります。
local: If you get to swim in the early morning in winter, it will put you in a good mood all day.
ja_pron: fuyu no sōchō ni oyogu koto ga dekireba, ichinichijū kibun ga yoku narimasu
native: If you get to swim in the early morning in winter, it will put you in a good mood all day.

en: A bit like drinking, a really good cup of coffee.
zh: 有點像喝一杯非常好的咖啡。
ja: まるで本当に美味しいコーヒーを飲むようなものです。
local: A bit like drinking, a really good cup of coffee.
ja_pron: marude hontō ni oishii kōhī o nomu yō na mono desu
native: A bit like drinking, a really good cup of coffee.

en: Not only does it give Xiaoshing locals a chance to swim in the winter,
zh: 這不僅讓紹興當地人有機會在冬天游泳，
ja: これは紹興の地元の人々に冬に泳ぐ機会を与えるだけでなく、
local: Not only does it give Xiaoshing locals a chance to swim in the winter,
ja_pron: kore wa Shōkō no jimoto no hitobito ni fuyu ni oyogu kikai o ataeru dake de naku
native: Not only does it give Xiaoshing locals a chance to swim in the winter,

en: but it also provides for another favourite winter pastime, deeply connected to local culture.
zh: 還提供了另一個深深連結當地文化的冬季愛好。
ja: さらに、地元文化と深く結びついた別の冬の楽しみも提供しています。
local: but it also provides for another favourite winter pastime, deeply connected to local culture.
ja_pron: sarani, jimoto bunka to fukaku musubitsuita betsu no fuyu no tanoshimi mo teikyō shiteimasu
native: but it also provides for another favourite winter pastime, deeply connected to local culture.

en: Not far from downtown Xiaoshing, there's an ancient part of town built by the water.
zh: 離紹興市中心不遠，有一個古老的水邊城區。
ja: 紹興の中心街からそう遠くない場所に、水辺に建てられた古い街があります。
local: Not far from downtown Xiaoshing, there's an ancient part of town built by the water.
ja_pron: Shōkō no chūshin-gai kara sō tōku nai basho ni, mizube ni taterareta furui machi ga arimasu
native: Not far from downtown Xiaoshing, there's an ancient part of town built by the water.

en: And in winter, the air here is thick with wine.
zh: 冬天，這裡的空氣中彌漫著酒香。
ja: 冬になると、ここでは空気が酒の香りで満ちています。
local: And in winter, the air here is thick with wine.
ja_pron: fuyu ni naru to, koko de wa kūki ga sake no kaori de michiteimasu
native: And in winter, the air here is thick with wine.

en: When winter comes, Xiaoshing's special yellow rice wine is brewed.
zh: 冬天來臨時，紹興特有的黃酒開始釀造。
ja: 冬が来ると、紹興の特別な黄酒が醸造されます。
local: When winter comes, Xiaoshing's special yellow rice wine is brewed.
ja_pron: fuyu ga kuru to, Shōkō no tokubetsu na kōshu ga jōzō saremasu
native: When winter comes, Xiaoshing's special yellow rice wine is brewed.

en: Some scholars believe that the emergence of wine signified a big change in human civilization.
zh: 一些學者認為酒的出現代表了人類文明的一大變革。
ja: 一部の学者は、酒の出現が人類文明の大きな変化を示したと考えています。
local: Some scholars believe that the emergence of wine signified a big change in human civilization.
ja_pron: ichibu no gakusha wa, sake no shutsugen ga jinrui bunmei no ōkina henka o shimeshita to kangaeteimasu
native: Some scholars believe that the emergence of wine signified a big change in human civilization.

en: In the end of food scarcity and the beginning of human socialization,
zh: 在食物短缺結束和人類社會化開始之際，
ja: 食料不足の終わりと人類の社会化の始まりにおいて、
local: In the end of food scarcity and the beginning of human socialization,
ja_pron: shokuryō fusoku no owari to jinrui no shakaika no hajimari ni oite
native: In the end of food scarcity and the beginning of human socialization,

en: the history of the yellow wine they make here in Xiaoshing is very rich.
zh: 紹興黃酒的歷史非常悠久。
ja: 紹興で作られる黄酒の歴史は非常に豊かです。
local: the history of the yellow wine they make here in Xiaoshing is very rich.
ja_pron: Shōkō de tsukurareru kōshu no rekishi wa hijō ni yutaka desu
native: the history of the yellow wine they make here in Xiaoshing is very rich.

en: It can be traced back to 2500 years ago.
zh: 可追溯到2500年前。
ja: 2500年前にさかのぼることができます。
local: It can be traced back to 2500 years ago.
ja_pron: nisen gohyaku nen mae ni sakanoboru koto ga dekimasu
native: It can be traced back to 2500 years ago.

en: The wet, stable environment and the clear water of the gentle lake play their part.
zh: 濕潤穩定的環境和溫和湖水發揮了作用。
ja: 湿潤で安定した環境と穏やかな湖の澄んだ水が役割を果たしています。
local: The wet, stable environment and the clear water of the gentle lake play their part.
ja_pron: shitsujun de antei shita kankyō to odayaka na mizuumi no sunda mizu ga yakuwari o hatashiteimasu
native: The wet, stable environment and the clear water of the gentle lake play their part.

en: It makes sense to begin the wine making process in winter.
zh: 在冬天開始釀酒過程是合理的。
ja: 冬に酒造りを始めるのは理にかなっています。
local: It makes sense to begin the wine making process in winter.
ja_pron: fuyu ni sakezukuri o hajimeru no wa ri ni kanatteimasu
native: It makes sense to begin the wine making process in winter.

en: The water is particularly clear then.
zh: 那時水特別清澈。
ja: その時、水は特に澄んでいます。
local: The water is particularly clear then.
ja_pron: sono toki, mizu wa toku ni sundeimasu
native: The water is particularly clear then.

en: The low temperatures limit the growth of bacteria, so fermentation can go may need according
zh: 低溫限制細菌生長，因此發酵可以按計劃進行。
ja: 低温は細菌の成長を抑え、発酵が計画通りに進むことを可能にします。
local: The low temperatures limit the growth of bacteria, so fermentation can go may need according
ja_pron: teion wa saikin no seichō o osaete, hakkō ga keikaku dōri ni susumu koto o kanō ni shimasu
native: The low temperatures limit the growth of bacteria, so fermentation can go may need according

en: to plan.
zh: 按計劃。
ja: 計画通りに。
local: to plan.
ja_pron: keikaku dōri ni
native: to plan.

en: And long fermentation at lower temperatures is best for flavour.
zh: 低溫長時間發酵對風味最佳。
ja: 低温での長時間発酵が風味に最適です。
local: And long fermentation at lower temperatures is best for flavour.
ja_pron: teion de no chōjikan hakkō ga fūmi ni saiteki desu
native: And long fermentation at lower temperatures is best for flavour.

en: At the beginning of the wine making season,
zh: 在釀酒季節開始時，
ja: 酒造りの季節の始まりに、
local: At the beginning of the wine making season,
ja_pron: sakezukuri no kisetsu no hajimari ni
native: At the beginning of the wine making season,

en: wine makers use the late water flowing past their door, carefully cleaning the various tools used in the brewing process.
zh: 釀酒師利用流經門前的晚水，仔細清洗釀造過程中使用的各種工具。
ja: 酒造り職人は、家の前を流れる遅い水を使い、醸造に使う様々な道具を丁寧に洗います。
local: wine makers use the late water flowing past their door, carefully cleaning the various tools used in the brewing process.
ja_pron: sakezukuri shokunin wa, ie no mae o nagareru osoi mizu o tsukai, jōzō ni tsukau samazama na dōgu o teinei ni araimasu
native: wine makers use the late water flowing past their door, carefully cleaning the various tools used in the brewing process.

en: And cover the pots for their new wine with a layer of antibacterial lime water.
zh: 並用一層抗菌石灰水覆蓋新酒的容器。
ja: そして新しい酒の壺を抗菌性の石灰水の層で覆います。
local: And cover the pots for their new wine with a layer of antibacterial lime water.
ja_pron: soshite atarashii sake no tsubo o kōkinsei no sekkaisui no sō de ōimasu
native: And cover the pots for their new wine with a layer of antibacterial lime water.

en: Origin tells me this town is where Chinese rice wine began.
zh: 據說這個城鎮是中國黃酒的起源地。
ja: この町が中国の黄酒の発祥の地だと伝えられています。
local: Origin tells me this town is where Chinese rice wine began.
ja_pron: kono machi ga chūgoku no kōshu no hasshō no chi da to tsutaerareteimasu
native: Origin tells me this town is where Chinese rice wine began.

en: In the Song Dynasty a thousand years ago, there were more than 500 wineries at one point.
zh: 宋朝一千年前，曾一度有超過500家酒廠。
ja: 宋の時代、千年前に一時期500以上の酒造所がありました。
local: In the Song Dynasty a thousand years ago, there were more than 500 wineries at one point.
ja_pron: Sō no jidai, sen nen mae ni ichiji 500 ijō no shuzōsho ga arimashita
native: In the Song Dynasty a thousand years ago, there were more than 500 wineries at one point.

en: What was the food today?
zh: 今天的食物是什麼？
ja: 今日の食べ物は何ですか？
local: What was the food today?
ja_pron: kyō no tabemono wa nan desu ka
native: What was the food today?

en: Mm-hmm.
zh: 嗯嗯。
ja: うんうん。
local: Mm-hmm.
ja_pron: un un
native: Mm-hmm.

native: Mm-hmm.

en: Look, I'm getting carried.
zh: 看，我快被帶走了。
ja: 見て、運ばれているよ。
local: Look, I'm getting carried.
ja_pron: mite, hakobarete iru yo
native: Look, I'm getting carried.

en: Here.
zh: 這裡。
ja: ここ。
local: Here.
ja_pron: koko
native: Here.

en: For thousands of years, people in Jiangsu and Zhou Dian got married,
zh: 數千年來，江蘇和周甸的人們結婚，
ja: 何千年もの間、江蘇と周甸の人々は結婚し、
local: For thousands of years, people in Jiangsu and Zhou Dian got married,
ja_pron: nansen nen mo, Kōso to Shūten no hitobito wa kekkon shi
native: For thousands of years, people in Jiangsu and Zhou Dian got married,

en: had kids, moved home, celebrated old age,
zh: 生孩子，搬家，慶祝長壽，
ja: 子供を産み、家を移し、長寿を祝いました。
local: had kids, moved home, celebrated old age,
ja_pron: kodomo o umi, ie o utsushi, chōju o iwaimashita
native: had kids, moved home, celebrated old age,

en: and on every occasion, they came laden with a jug of rice wine.
zh: 每逢場合，他們都帶著一壺黃酒。
ja: どんな時でも、彼らは壺いっぱいの黄酒を持ってきました。
local: and on every occasion, they came laden with a jug of rice wine.
ja_pron: donna toki demo, karera wa tsubo ippai no kōshu o motte kimashita
native: and on every occasion, they came laden with a jug of rice wine.

en: The full of the jug, the more intense the emotion.
zh: 壺越滿，情感越深。
ja: 壺がいっぱいであればあるほど、感情は強くなります。
local: The full of the jug, the more intense the emotion.
ja_pron: tsubo ga ippai de areba aru hodo, kanjō wa tsuyoku narimasu
native: The full of the jug, the more intense the emotion.

en: The key to the quality of the rice wine is the beast.
zh: 米酒品質的關鍵在於這種酵母。
ja: 米酒の品質の鍵はこの酵母にあります。
local: The key to the quality of the rice wine is the beast.
ja_pron: komezake no hinshitsu no kagi wa kono kōbo ni arimasu
native: The key to the quality of the rice wine is the beast.

en: This is the essence of Chinese wine making.
zh: 這是中國釀酒的精髓。
ja: これは中国の酒造りの本質です。
local: This is the essence of Chinese wine making.
ja_pron: kore wa chūgoku no sakazukuri no honshitsu desu
native: This is the essence of Chinese wine making.

en: It derived from grain milieu.
zh: 它源自穀物環境。
ja: それは穀物の環境から生まれました。
local: It derived from grain milieu.
ja_pron: sore wa kokumotsu no kankyō kara umaremashita
native: It derived from grain milieu.

en: The microorganisms in it are some kind of mold or fungus.
zh: 其中的微生物是一種黴菌或真菌。
ja: その中の微生物は一種のカビや菌類です。
local: The microorganisms in it are some kind of mold or fungus.
ja_pron: sono naka no biseibutsu wa isshu no kabi ya kinrui desu
native: The microorganisms in it are some kind of mold or fungus.

en: The use of mold is a major invention of the Chinese.
zh: 使用黴菌是中國人的重大發明。
ja: カビの使用は中国人の大きな発明です。
local: The use of mold is a major invention of the Chinese.
ja_pron: kabi no shiyō wa chūgokujin no ōkina hatsumei desu
native: The use of mold is a major invention of the Chinese.

en: Some say it's comparable to the four great inventions of ancient China.
zh: 有人說它可與中國古代四大發明相提並論。
ja: それは古代中国の四大発明に匹敵すると言われています。
local: Some say it's comparable to the four great inventions of ancient China.
ja_pron: sore wa kodai chūgoku no shidai hatsumei ni hitteki suru to iwarete imasu
native: Some say it's comparable to the four great inventions of ancient China.

en: This fragrant sticky rice and water from the lake will change under the
zh: 這種芳香的糯米和湖水會在
ja: この香り高いもち米と湖の水は、
local: This fragrant sticky rice and water from the lake will change under the
ja_pron: kono kaori takai mochigome to mizu wa,
native: This fragrant sticky rice and water from the lake will change under the

en: the implements of this beast.
zh: 這種酵母的作用下發生變化。
ja: この酵母の働きによって変化します。
local: the implements of this beast.
ja_pron: kono kōbo no hataraki ni yotte henka shimasu
native: the implements of this beast.

en: They will go on a three-month journey together.
zh: 它們將共同經歷三個月的變化過程。
ja: それらは一緒に三ヶ月の旅をします。
local: They will go on a three-month journey together.
ja_pron: sorera wa issho ni sankagetsu no tabi o shimasu
native: They will go on a three-month journey together.

en: And when Next Spring comes, then newly brewed liquor
zh: 當下一個春天來臨時，新釀的酒
ja: そして次の春が来ると、新しく醸造された酒が
local: And when Next Spring comes, then newly brewed liquor
ja_pron: soshite tsugi no haru ga kuru to, atarashiku jōzō sareta sake ga
native: And when Next Spring comes, then newly brewed liquor

en: will be taken out to continue its journey,
zh: 將被取出繼續其旅程，
ja: 取り出されて旅を続けます。
local: will be taken out to continue its journey,
ja_pron: toridasarete tabi o tsuzukemasu
native: will be taken out to continue its journey,

en: eventually becoming a full-body amber-coloured aged wine.
zh: 最終成為濃郁琥珀色的陳年酒。
ja: 最終的に濃厚な琥珀色の熟成酒になります。
local: eventually becoming a full-body amber-coloured aged wine.
ja_pron: saishūteki ni nōkō na kohaku-iro no jukusei-shu ni narimasu
native: eventually becoming a full-body amber-coloured aged wine.

en: In Shaoxian, there is a special rice wine called red daughter.
zh: 紹興有一種特別的米酒叫做紅女兒。
ja: 紹興には「紅娘」と呼ばれる特別な米酒があります。
local: In Shaoxian, there is a special rice wine called red daughter.
ja_pron: shōkō ni wa 'kōnyō' to yobareru tokubetsu na komezake ga arimasu
native: In Shaoxian, there is a special rice wine called red daughter.

en: In ancient times, better off families would make it when a daughter was born.
zh: 古時候，富裕家庭會在女兒出生時釀造它。
ja: 昔は裕福な家庭が娘の誕生時にこれを作りました。
local: In ancient times, better off families would make it when a daughter was born.
ja_pron: mukashi wa yūfuku na katei ga musume no tanjōji ni kore o tsukurimashita
native: In ancient times, better off families would make it when a daughter was born.

en: Her father would take home-grown gluttonous rice, make three jugs of yellow wine, and seal
zh: 她的父親會帶回自家種植的糯米，釀造三壺黃酒，然後封存
ja: 彼女の父親は自家栽培のもち米を持ち帰り、黄酒を三壺作り、封印します。
local: Her father would take home-grown gluttonous rice, make three jugs of yellow wine, and seal
ja_pron: kanojo no chichioya wa jika saibai no mochigome o mochikaeri, kōshu o san ko tsukuri, fūin shimasu
native: Her father would take home-grown gluttonous rice, make three jugs of yellow wine, and seal

en: them up before burying them in the yard.
zh: 然後封存後埋在院子裡。
ja: それらを封印して庭に埋めます。
local: them up before burying them in the yard.
ja_pron: sorera o fūin shite niwa ni umemasu
native: them up before burying them in the yard.

en: When the daughter reached 18 and left home to get married, it would be dug out as a dowry.
zh: 當女兒18歲出嫁時，會將酒挖出作為嫁妝。
ja: 娘が18歳になって嫁ぐ時、その酒は持参金として掘り出されます。
local: When the daughter reached 18 and left home to get married, it would be dug out as a dowry.
ja_pron: musume ga 18-sai ni natte yomegu toki, sono sake wa jisan-kin to shite horidasaremasu
native: When the daughter reached 18 and left home to get married, it would be dug out as a dowry.

en: The wine symbolizes no less than the love of a father for his daughter.
zh: 這酒象徵著父親對女兒的深厚愛意。
ja: この酒は父親の娘への深い愛情を象徴しています。
local: The wine symbolizes no less than the love of a father for his daughter.
ja_pron: kono sake wa chichioya no musume e no fukai aijō o shōchō shite imasu
native: The wine symbolizes no less than the love of a father for his daughter.

en: With the increasing demand for rice wine at the market, Shaoxian has a lot of factories
zh: 隨著市場對米酒需求增加，紹興有許多酒廠
ja: 市場での米酒の需要が増えるにつれて、紹興には多くの工場があります。
local: With the increasing demand for rice wine at the market, Shaoxian has a lot of factories
ja_pron: ichiba de no komezake no juyō ga fueru ni tsurete, shōkō ni wa ōku no kōjō ga arimasu
native: With the increasing demand for rice wine at the market, Shaoxian has a lot of factories

en: making wine.
zh: 生產米酒。
ja: 酒を製造しています。
local: making wine.
ja_pron: sake o seizō shite imasu
native: making wine.

en: Factory production is the main thing, and improved efficiency on the production line
zh: 工廠生產是主要方式，生產線效率的提升
ja: 工場生産が主で、生産ラインの効率向上が
local: Factory production is the main thing, and improved efficiency on the production line
ja_pron: kōjō seisan ga omode, seisan rain no kōritsu kōjō ga
native: Factory production is the main thing, and improved efficiency on the production line

en: has made a big difference to the quality of rice wine.
zh: 對米酒品質產生了巨大影響。
ja: 米酒の品質に大きな違いをもたらしました。
local: has made a big difference to the quality of rice wine.
ja_pron: komezake no hinshitsu ni ōkina chigai o motarashimashita
native: has made a big difference to the quality of rice wine.

en: These companies now produce more than 440,000 tons of rice wine a year, and your sales have
zh: 這些公司現在每年生產超過44萬噸米酒，銷售額已達
ja: これらの会社は現在、年間44万トン以上の米酒を生産し、売上は
local: These companies now produce more than 440,000 tons of rice wine a year, and your sales have
ja_pron: korera no kaisha wa genzai, nenkan 44 man ton ijō no komezake o seisan shi, uriage wa
native: These companies now produce more than 440,000 tons of rice wine a year, and your sales have

en: reached a whopping 3.45 billion yen.
zh: 達到驚人的34.5億日元。
ja: 驚異的な34.5億円に達しています。
local: reached a whopping 3.45 billion yen.
ja_pron: kyōiteki na sanjūyon oku gohyaku man en ni tasshite imasu
native: reached a whopping 3.45 billion yen.

en: No matter how huge the scale of production these days or how advanced the equipment,
zh: 無論如今生產規模多大或設備多先進，
ja: 最近の生産規模がどんなに大きくても、設備がどんなに進んでいても、
local: No matter how huge the scale of production these days or how advanced the equipment,
ja_pron: saikin no seisan kibo ga donna ni ōkikute mo, setsubi ga donna ni susunde ite mo,
native: No matter how huge the scale of production these days or how advanced the equipment,

en: the quality of Shaoxian rice wine remains tightly controlled.
zh: 紹興米酒的品質仍然嚴格控制。
ja: 紹興米酒の品質は厳しく管理されています。
local: the quality of Shaoxian rice wine remains tightly controlled.
ja_pron: shōkō komezake no hinshitsu wa kibishiku kanri sarete imasu
native: the quality of Shaoxian rice wine remains tightly controlled.

en: The temperature at Leedong and the Dinnigour water quality still determine the taste.
zh: 麗東的溫度和丁尼溝的水質仍然決定著口感。
ja: 麗東の温度と丁尼溝の水質が味を決定しています。
local: The temperature at Leedong and the Dinnigour water quality still determine the taste.
ja_pron: reitō no ondo to chōnigō no suishitsu ga aji o kettei shite imasu
native: The temperature at Leedong and the Dinnigour water quality still determine the taste.

en: Wine makers in the factories are all inheritors of techniques developed over the centuries.
zh: 工廠裡的釀酒師都是世代相傳的技術繼承者。
ja: 工場の酒造り職人は皆、何世紀にもわたって発展してきた技術の継承者です。
local: Wine makers in the factories are all inheritors of techniques developed over the centuries.
ja_pron: kōjō no sakazukuri shokunin wa mina, nanseiki ni mo watatte hatten shite kita gijutsu no keishōsha desu
native: Wine makers in the factories are all inheritors of techniques developed over the centuries.

en: Think about it.
zh: 想想看。
ja: 考えてみてください。
local: Think about it.
ja_pron: kangaete mite kudasai
native: Think about it.

zh: 如果你住在這樣一個被水環繞的湖邊城市，這裡生產美味的飲品，
ja: もしあなたが水に囲まれた湖のそばの、美味しい飲み物を生産する街に住んでいたら、
local: If you live next to such a lake surrounded by water in a city that produces tasty drinks,
ja_pron: moshi anata ga mizu ni kakomareta mizuumi no soba no, oishii nomimono o seisan suru machi ni sunde itara,

en: how would you entertain yourself?
zh: 你會怎麼娛樂自己？
ja: あなたはどうやって楽しみますか？
local: how would you entertain yourself?
ja_pron: anata wa dō yatte tanoshimimasu ka?
native: how would you entertain yourself?

en: What Chinese aristocrats came up with a thousand years ago is pretty romantic.
zh: 中國貴族一千年前想出的點子相當浪漫。
ja: 中国の貴族が千年前に考えたことはとてもロマンチックです。
local: What Chinese aristocrats came up with a thousand years ago is pretty romantic.
ja_pron: chūgoku no kizoku ga sennen mae ni kangaeta koto wa totemo romanchikku desu
native: What Chinese aristocrats came up with a thousand years ago is pretty romantic.

en: They call it a two-shrly leo of Shaox, a kind of river drinking game.
zh: 他們稱之為紹興的「兩小時賽酒」，一種河邊飲酒遊戲。
ja: それを紹興の「二時間酒遊び」と呼び、川辺の飲み会の一種です。
local: They call it a two-shrly leo of Shaox, a kind of river drinking game.
ja_pron: sore o shōkō no 'nijikan sake asobi' to yobi, kawabe no nomikai no isshu desu
native: They call it a two-shrly leo of Shaox, a kind of river drinking game.

en: People sit on both sides of the canal, a glass of wine is filled upstream and set to float
zh: 人們坐在運河兩岸，上游倒滿一杯酒，讓它漂流
ja: 人々は運河の両側に座り、上流でグラスに酒を注ぎ、それを流します。
local: People sit on both sides of the canal, a glass of wine is filled upstream and set to float
ja_pron: hitobito wa unga no ryōgawa ni suwari, jōryū de gurasu ni sake o sosogi, sore o nagashimasu
native: People sit on both sides of the canal, a glass of wine is filled upstream and set to float

en: downstream.
zh: 順流而下。
ja: 下流へと流れます。
local: downstream.
ja_pron: karyū e to nagaremasu
native: downstream.

en: Whoever it stops by or overturns next to has to make up a poem on the spot.
zh: 酒停靠或翻倒的人必須即興作詩。
ja: 酒が止まったり、ひっくり返った人はその場で詩を作らなければなりません。
local: Whoever it stops by or overturns next to has to make up a poem on the spot.
ja_pron: sake ga tomattari, hikkurikaetta hito wa sono ba de shi o tsukuranakereba narimasen
native: Whoever it stops by or overturns next to has to make up a poem on the spot.

en: Or they have to drink if they can't think of anything.
zh: 如果想不出詩，就得喝酒。
ja: もし詩が思いつかなければ、酒を飲まなければなりません。
local: Or they have to drink if they can't think of anything.
ja_pron: moshi shi ga omoitsukanakereba, sake o nomanakereba narimasen
native: Or they have to drink if they can't think of anything.

en: Such a party would often end in drunkenness, and what we're left with is a stack of the
zh: 這樣的聚會常以醉酒結束，留下的是一堆
ja: そのような宴会はしばしば酔っぱらいで終わり、残るのは
local: Such a party would often end in drunkenness, and what we're left with is a stack of the

native: Such a party would often end in drunkenness, and what we're left with is a stack of the

en: most beautiful heartfelt poetry in China.
zh: 中國最美麗的真摯詩篇。
ja: 中国で最も美しい心のこもった詩の束です。
local: most beautiful heartfelt poetry in China.
ja_pron: chūgoku de mottomo utsukushii kokoro no komotta shi no taba desu
native: most beautiful heartfelt poetry in China.

en: The people here have inherited this romanticism.
zh: 這裡的人們繼承了這份浪漫情懷。
ja: ここに住む人々はこのロマンチシズムを受け継いでいます。
local: The people here have inherited this romanticism.
ja_pron: koko ni sumu hitobito wa kono romanchishizumu o uketsuide imasu
native: The people here have inherited this romanticism.

en: It might be 2,500 years old, but Shaoxian wine culture is still going strong.
zh: 紹興酒文化可能已有2500年歷史，但仍然蓬勃發展。
ja: 2500年の歴史があるかもしれませんが、紹興の酒文化は今も盛んです。
local: It might be 2,500 years old, but Shaoxian wine culture is still going strong.
ja_pron: 2500-nen no rekishi ga aru kamoshiremasen ga, shōkō no sake bunka wa ima mo sakan desu
native: It might be 2,500 years old, but Shaoxian wine culture is still going strong.

en: The ingredients are pretty ordinary, but the taste is uniquely Shaoxian.
zh: 原料相當普通，但味道獨具紹興特色。
ja: 材料はかなり普通ですが、味は紹興独特です。
local: The ingredients are pretty ordinary, but the taste is uniquely Shaoxian.
ja_pron: zairyō wa kanari futsū desu ga, aji wa shōkō dokutoku desu
native: The ingredients are pretty ordinary, but the taste is uniquely Shaoxian.

en: After visiting the winter brewing scene of Shaoxian, I find winter swimming and rice
zh: 參觀紹興冬季釀造場景後，我發現冬泳和米酒
ja: 紹興の冬の醸造現場を訪れた後、冬の水泳と米酒が
local: After visiting the winter brewing scene of Shaoxian, I find winter swimming and rice
ja_pron: shōkō no fuyu no jōzō genba o otozureta ato, fuyu no suiei to kome
native: After visiting the winter brewing scene of Shaoxian, I find winter swimming and rice

en: wine making have pretty much the same purpose.
zh: 釀造有著相似的目的。
ja: 酒造りはほぼ同じ目的を持っていることに気づきました。
local: wine making have pretty much the same purpose.
ja_pron: sakazukuri wa hobo onaji mokuteki o motte iru koto ni kizukimashita
native: wine making have pretty much the same purpose.

en: Winter swimming is for adapting to changes in season, shifting from summer to autumn to
zh: 冬泳是為了適應季節變化，從夏天轉換到秋天再到
ja: 冬の水泳は季節の変化に適応するためで、夏から秋、そして
local: Winter swimming is for adapting to changes in season, shifting from summer to autumn to
ja_pron: fuyu no suiei wa kisetsu no henka ni tekiō suru tame de, natsu kara aki, soshite
native: Winter swimming is for adapting to changes in season, shifting from summer to autumn to

en: winter in people and in nature.
zh: 人與自然中進入冬季。
ja: 人々と自然が冬に移ることです。
local: winter in people and in nature.
ja_pron: hitobito to shizen ga fuyu ni utsuru koto desu
native: winter in people and in nature.

en: This involves mutual coordination and adaptation.
zh: 這涉及相互協調與適應。
ja: これは相互の調整と適応を含みます。
local: This involves mutual coordination and adaptation.
ja_pron: kore wa sōgo no chōsei to tekiō o fukumimasu
native: This involves mutual coordination and adaptation.

en: The same is true of wine making, starting from the beginning of winter, water and glutinous
zh: 釀酒也是如此，從冬季開始，水和糯米
ja: 酒造りも同様で、冬の始まりから水ともち米が
local: The same is true of wine making, starting from the beginning of winter, water and glutinous
ja_pron: sakazukuri mo dōyō de, fuyu no hajimari kara mizu to mochigome ga
native: The same is true of wine making, starting from the beginning of winter, water and glutinous

en: rice are mixed with yeast.
zh: 與酵母混合。
ja: 酵母と混ぜられます。
local: rice are mixed with yeast.
ja_pron: kōbo to mazeraremasu
native: rice are mixed with yeast.

en: A long coordination and adaptation process take place.
zh: 進行長時間的協調與適應過程。
ja: 長い調整と適応の過程が行われます。
local: A long coordination and adaptation process take place.
ja_pron: nagai chōsei to tekiō no katei ga okonawaremasu
native: A long coordination and adaptation process take place.

en: In spring of the following year, the pulp of the original ingredients has turned into
zh: 隔年春天，原料的漿糊已轉變為

local: clear sweet wine, and the role of all gins captain of the swimming team matches that of
ja_pron: sunda amai sake ni kawari, suiei chīmu no kyaputen no yakuwari ga
native: clear sweet wine, and the role of all gins captain of the swimming team matches that of

zh: 釀酒過程中的酵母相匹配。
ja: 酒造りの過程の酵母と一致します。
local: the yeast in the wine making process.
ja_pron: sakazukuri no katei no kōbo to icchi shimasu
native: the yeast in the wine making process.

en: Passion and energy come together.
zh: 熱情與能量融合。
ja: 情熱とエネルギーが一体となります。
local: Passion and energy come together.
ja_pron: jōnetsu to enerugī ga ittai to narimasu
native: Passion and energy come together.

en: The swimmers are put through their paces, carrying out the custom of lead on winter swimming
zh: 游泳者接受訓練，執行紹興冬泳的傳統習俗。
ja: 泳者たちは訓練を受け、紹興の冬泳の習慣を実行します。
local: The swimmers are put through their paces, carrying out the custom of lead on winter swimming
ja_pron: oyogimono-tachi wa kunren o uke, shōkō no fuyu-ei no shūkan o jikkō shimasu
native: The swimmers are put through their paces, carrying out the custom of lead on winter swimming

en: in Shaoxian.
zh: 在紹興。
ja: 紹興で。
local: in Shaoxian.
ja_pron: shōkō de
native: in Shaoxian.

en: On the fifth day of winter, the annual National Winter Swimming Championships kicks off.
zh: 冬季第五天，全國冬泳錦標賽正式開始。
ja: 冬の5日目に、毎年恒例の全国冬泳選手権大会が始まります。
local: On the fifth day of winter, the annual National Winter Swimming Championships kicks off.
ja_pron: fuyu no itsuka-me ni, maitoshi kōrei no zenkoku fuyu-ei senshuken taikai ga hajimarimasu
native: On the fifth day of winter, the annual National Winter Swimming Championships kicks off.

en: From 18 to 69 years old, more than 3,500 could test from all over China, a year to participate
zh: 年齡從18到69歲，來自全中國的3500多人每年參加比賽，
ja: 18歳から69歳まで、全国から3500人以上が毎年参加します。
local: From 18 to 69 years old, more than 3,500 could test from all over China, a year to participate
ja_pron: 18-sai kara 69-sai made, zenkoku kara 3500-nin ijō ga maitoshi sanka shimasu
native: From 18 to 69 years old, more than 3,500 could test from all over China, a year to participate

en: in this winter swimming competition.
zh: 參加這場冬泳比賽。
ja: この冬泳大会に参加します。
local: in this winter swimming competition.
ja_pron: kono fuyu-ei taikai ni sanka shimasu
native: in this winter swimming competition.

en: All gins is bringing his team over, and they are looking very sportsman-like.
zh: 所有選手都帶著他的隊伍過來，他們看起來非常有運動家風範。
ja: すべての選手がチームを連れてきており、とてもスポーツマンらしく見えます。
local: All gins is bringing his team over, and they are looking very sportsman-like.
native: All gins is bringing his team over, and they are looking very sportsman-like.

en: It's too warm, so in order to reach the required water temperature for racing, staff
zh: 天氣太暖和了，因此為了達到比賽所需的水溫，工作人員
ja: 気温が高すぎるため、レースに必要な水温に達するためにスタッフは

native: It's too warm, so in order to reach the required water temperature for racing, staff

zh: 陸續將巨大的冰塊放入泳道中。
ja: 次々と巨大な氷の塊をレーンに入れています。
local: have put huge blocks of ice into the lanes one after another.
native: have put huge blocks of ice into the lanes one after another.

en: Everything's ready, and the race is about to begin.
zh: 一切準備就緒，比賽即將開始。
ja: すべての準備が整い、レースがまもなく始まろうとしています。
local: Everything's ready, and the race is about to begin.
native: Everything's ready, and the race is about to begin.

en: It's not so much a race as a winter swimming site, the level of excitement is far more intense
zh: 這不僅僅是一場比賽，更像是一個冬泳的場所，興奮的程度遠遠超過比賽本身，
ja: これは単なるレースというよりも冬の水泳の場であり、興奮のレベルは競争以上にずっと高いです。
local: It's not so much a race as a winter swimming site, the level of excitement is far more intense
native: It's not so much a race as a winter swimming site, the level of excitement is far more intense

en: than it would just about the competition.
zh: 比起單純的競賽來說更為激烈。
ja: 単なる競技よりもはるかに激しいのです。
local: than it would just about the competition.
native: than it would just about the competition.

en: In China, there's simply far more water in the south than in the north, so it's easier
zh: 在中國，南方的水資源遠比北方豐富，因此更容易
ja: 中国では南の方が北よりもはるかに水が多いため、より簡単に
local: In China, there's simply far more water in the south than in the north, so it's easier
native: In China, there's simply far more water in the south than in the north, so it's easier

en: to raise a swimmer, and it's easier to make a rich wine.
zh: 培養游泳選手，也更容易釀造出濃郁的美酒。
ja: 水泳選手を育てることも、豊かなワインを作ることも簡単です。
local: to raise a swimmer, and it's easier to make a rich wine.
native: to raise a swimmer, and it's easier to make a rich wine.

en: Whether swimming or wine making, lead on is a special time for both.
zh: 無論是游泳還是釀酒，立冬都是兩者的重要時刻。
ja: 水泳でもワイン作りでも、立冬はどちらにとっても特別な時期です。
local: Whether swimming or wine making, lead on is a special time for both.
native: Whether swimming or wine making, lead on is a special time for both.

en: It is the solar term that requires both hard work and patience to get what you want.
zh: 這是個節氣，需要努力和耐心才能達成目標。
ja: これは努力と忍耐が必要な節気であり、望むものを得るための時期です。
local: It is the solar term that requires both hard work and patience to get what you want.
native: It is the solar term that requires both hard work and patience to get what you want.
